summary: 3D Systems Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $40 million common stock offering at an unspecified price per share; the last sale price was $3.88 on June 2, 2026. Underwriters are Needham Company and Craig-Hallum, with a 30-day overallotment option of $6 million. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
